The '''King [[Alfonso XIII]]'s Cup 1926''' was the 26th staging of the [[Copa del Rey]], the Spanish [[association football|football]] cup competition.

The competition began on 28 February 1926, and concluded on 16 May 1926 with the final, held at the [[Mestalla Stadium|Mestalla]] in [[Valencia]], in which [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] lifted the trophy for the seventh time following a 3–2 victory over [[Atlético Madrid|Athletic Madrid]].

==Teams==
For the first time ever, runners-up of each regional championship were able to participate in the tournament. So the tournament was expanded to 24 teams.

* '''[[Aragón Regional Championship|Aragón Region]]''': [[Iberia SC]], [[Zaragoza CD]]
* '''[[Regional Championship of Asturias|Asturias Region]]''': [[Sporting de Gijón]], [[Fortuna de Gijón]]
* '''[[Cantabrian Championship|Cantabria Region]]''': [[Racing de Santander]], [[Gimnástica de Torrelavega]]
* '''[[Campeonato de Castilla y León|Castile and León Region]]''': [[Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa]], [[Real Unión Deportiva]]
* '''[[Catalan football championship|Catalonia Region]]''': [[FC Barcelona]], [[RCD Español]]
* '''[[Galician Championship|Galicia Region]]''': [[Celta de Vigo]], [[Deportivo de La Coruña]]
* '''[[Gipuzkoa Championship|Gipuzkoa Region]]''': [[Real Unión]], [[Real Sociedad]]
* '''[[Levante Championship|Murcia Region]]''': [[Real Murcia]], [[Cartagena CF|Cartagena FC]]
* '''[[Campeonato Regional Centro|Centre Region]]''': [[Real Madrid]], [[Atlético Madrid|Athletic Madrid]]
* '''[[Campeonato Regional Sur|South Region]]''': [[Sevilla FC]], [[Real Betis]]
* '''[[Levante Championship|Levante Region]]''': [[Valencia CF]], [[Levante FC]]
* '''[[Biscay Championship|Biscay Region]]''': [[Athletic Bilbao]], [[Arenas Club de Getxo|Arenas Club]]
